model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the convergence of loss values over iterations for five different model configurations, with the y-axis representing "Loss" on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 and the x-axis representing "#Iteration" on a linear scale from 0 to 140000. The legend identifies five distinct lines: "Vanilla" (purple), "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue), "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange), "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (green), and "SepLLM (n=128)" (red). All five lines start at a loss of approximately 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a sharp initial decrease in loss, followed by a gradual decline as iterations increase. By iteration 140000, the loss values for all models have stabilized, with the "Vanilla" model showing the highest final loss (around 2.6), followed by "StrmLLM (n=64)" (around 2.58), "SepLLM (n=64)" (around 2.57), "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (around 2.57), and "SepLLM (n=128)" (around 2.56), indicating a slightly lower loss for the "SepLLM (n=128)" model at the end of training.
